description: Requires an agent API key (Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key). Get the exact EIP-712 DeliveryReceipt typed data to sign for one query on a funded session (queryHash = sha256(query), stepIndex = queries_used + 1). Args: session_id, query (the exact text you will send). Sign it with the buyer_address key and pass the 65-byte signature as delivery_receipt. REST twin: GET /api/v1/data-sessions/{session_id}/signing-payload?query=. Next: data_session_query with delivery_receipt.

inputSchema.description: Session id plus the exact query text the DeliveryReceipt will cover.

query.description: Exact query text you will send to data_session_query. queryHash is sha256 of this text, so sign for the same string you query with.
query.title: Query

session_id.description: UUID of a data session you opened (from data_session_open).
session_id.title: Session Id

inputSchema.title: DataSessionSigningPayloadInput

name: data_session_signing_payload
